dish.B.en: BBQ pork and empress chicken over rice

dish.C.en: Broccoli w/ sliced sauted chicken over rice

cancelled.flash.zh: 付款未完成，訂單尚未成立。您的選擇會暫留一段時間 — 可在下方再試一次。
cancelled.flash.en: Payment was not completed, so your order was not placed. Your selections are held for a short time — you can try again below.

banner.explore_opens.zh: 您可以先填寫表格。結帳於 {date} 開放。
banner.explore_opens.en: You can explore the form now. Checkout opens {date}.

banner.explore_not_yet.zh: 您可以先填寫表格。結帳尚未開放。
banner.explore_not_yet.en: You can explore the form now. Checkout is not available yet.

banner.open_now.en: You can place your order now.

banner.closed_body.zh: 您仍可瀏覽表格，但已無法結帳。截止時間：{date}。
banner.closed_body.en: You can still look around, but checkout is no longer available. Window ended {date}.

banner.admin_closed_body.zh: 您可以瀏覽表格，但教會辦公室已暫停結帳。
banner.admin_closed_body.en: You can explore the form, but checkout is paused by the church office.

details.heading.zh: 個人/小組組長/家長 資料

details.contact_required.zh: 請輸入電郵或電話號碼.
details.contact_required.en: Please enter an email or phone number.

details.phone.zh: Phone (建議使用電郵以便收到電子收據。)

details.contact_error.zh: 請輸入有效的電郵或電話號碼。
details.contact_error.en: Please enter a valid email or a phone number.

campus.not_configured_body.zh: 請聯絡教會辦公室 — 須先設定會堂才能繼續網上訂購。
campus.not_configured_body.en: Please contact the church office — online ordering cannot continue until campuses are defined.

campus.error.en: Please choose a campus to continue.

lift.no_life_group.en: I don't join a Life Group

attendance.adult_error.zh: 至少需要一位非12歲或以下的出席者。
attendance.adult_error.en: At least one person who is not 12 or under is required.

checkout.title_window.zh: 僅在訂購時段內可結帳
checkout.title_window.en: Checkout is only available during the ordering window

checkout.title_not_open.zh: 訂購尚未開放 — 可先填寫表格，但暫時無法結帳
checkout.title_not_open.en: Ordering has not opened yet — you can fill the form, but checkout is not available

modal.pay_note_elements.zh: 下一步將前往付款頁面以信用卡支付此金額。付款成功後訂單才算確認。
modal.pay_note_elements.en: Next you'll continue to our payment page to pay this amount by card. Your order is confirmed only after payment succeeds.

modal.pay_note_hosted.zh: 下一步將前往 Stripe 以信用卡支付此金額。付款成功後訂單才算確認。
modal.pay_note_hosted.en: Next you'll be taken to Stripe to pay this amount by card. Your order is confirmed only after payment succeeds.

modal.rsvp_note.zh: 您的出席將被記錄，無需付款。
modal.rsvp_note.en: Your attendance will be recorded. No payment is required.

modal.email_none.zh: （無 — 確認信將寄至教會辦公室）
